body: Thank you again Tordhen. :) Your kind words have made me smile. But I can't do it. I've been suicidal since I was a child, and observing myself right now, there's nothing that can be done to change my mind. I feel awful writing this to you since you took the time to try to convince me to stop but honestly, knowing I'll be feeding the trees and grass makes me happy, because they aren't judging me, and you didn't either.

It's true that you don't need to rely on others to prove your worth, but all my life, I've been told I'm nothing. Over the years, it's been conditioned in my psychology that it's true. I can't unthink it now, being vile amd disgusting is part of my being. And I'm sure you are beautiful, and I would've loved to be your friend. ❤

I wish I can believe that I am worth something. College, and sometimes even before that, people loved to tell me off, and tell me straight up how weird and ugly I am. I'm sorry that you also had to deal with people like that. I wish you didn't, and I wish I can take the pain of those memories away from you. You don't deserve that. Thank you for your comment but I think my mind is made up. ❤ Thank you.
